title: Riot and Failure to Disperse
grade_or_penalty: Riot: 3rd degree if the actor leads or incites or is armed; otherwise 4th degree. Failure to disperse: disorderly persons
key_points: Riot: participating with four or more others in a course of disorderly conduct to commit a crime, prevent official action, or while armed.
Failure to disperse: refusing an officer's lawful order to disperse when there is substantial harm or riot.
